WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
), regional_comparison AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        region,
        account_count,
        AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS regional_average
    FROM district_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        region,
        account_count,
        regional_average,
        account_count - regional_average AS excess_count
    FROM regional_comparison
    WHERE account_count > regional_average
), scored AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        region,
        account_count,
        excess_count,
        CAST(account_count AS REAL) /
            AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT district_id, region, account_count, excess_count, ratio
FROM scored
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The regional and overall averages are unweighted averages of district account counts, with one row per district that has at least one account; districts with no accounts are excluded because the request counts accounts by branch district.
